MTL Explorer Release v.0.8.1

Released 19 August 2026

Clearer map update notices and reliable track visibility during large imports.

  • Fixed the map update notice reappearing after it was dismissed.
  • Fixed successfully imported GPS tracks remaining hidden while large imports were still running.
  • Reduced duplicate status requests with shared eight-second polling.
